note: Pivot/axis geometry below is measured directly from LM_* landmarks (exact). Angle ranges are ENGINEERING DEFAULTS, not measured/verified against real hinge hardware - see rotation_range_source. Equality/inequality constraints below are the current mesh-quality/attachment rules the deform() and validator enforce.

left.rotation_range_source: CONFIGURABLE_ENGINEERING_DEFAULT - not derived from this model; edit here to match your real hinge hardware spec.

right.rotation_range_source: CONFIGURABLE_ENGINEERING_DEFAULT - not derived from this model; edit here to match your real hinge hardware spec.

equality_constraints.implementation_notes: Enforced structurally: all basis rules are symmetric about X=0 by construction, so LM_BridgeCenter never moves under any of the 5 parameters. Checked in validate_template.py.
Verified on template load and after every deform() call by mirroring X and comparing Y/Z.

parameters.description: temple root vertex must coincide with hinge pivot after any deformation

equality_constraints.implementation_notes: Guaranteed by construction for temple_length (pivots at root) and frame_width/bridge_width (hinge+temple translate together, same rigid shift). NOT guaranteed if you compose rotate_hinge() with a stale pre-deform vertex array - always rotate AFTER deform().

parameters.description: temple root stays adjacent to its (rigid) TempleJoint housing

equality_constraints.implementation_notes: NOT actively enforced - TempleJoint is rigid while temple_length can stretch the temple. Flagged as a known gap in basis_metadata.json.

parameters.description: lens boundary should remain within/at the frame rim opening

inequality_constraints.implementation_notes: NOT implemented - lens_width/lens_height/bridge_width move the lens independently of the frame rim (documented limitation in basis_metadata.json). This constraint exists here as a placeholder for the v2 rim-following basis.
Enforced in rotate_hinge() callers should clamp angle_deg to [min_angle_deg, max_angle_deg] before calling; the engine itself does not currently clamp - caller responsibility, flagged for v2.
Checked in validate_template.py mesh-quality pass: flags any edge whose deformed length exceeds 3x its rest length as severe stretching.
NOT implemented - true self-intersection testing (e.g. BVH-based triangle-triangle intersection) is expensive and was out of scope for this pass. Flagged as an open gap.

design_change_v1_1: bridge_width no longer rigidly shifts LeftHinge/RightHinge/LeftTempleJoint/RightTempleJoint - see deformation/build_basis.py docstring. bridge_width is now a local nasal/rim parameter; frame_width remains the whole-assembly-width parameter that does move the hinge/temple.
